account.error_current: That is not your current password.
account.error_mismatch: The new passwords do not match.
account.error_short: The new password is too short.
account.error_username: The password cannot be your username.
account.intro: Password and interface language. Changing the password does not sign you out here.
account.rule: At least {count} characters. A long sentence beats a short password full of symbols.
account.title: Your account
admin.default_password: This account still has its installation password. Change it before anyone else can reach the hub.
admin.masking_off: No entity type is selected, so the hub masks nothing: text reaches the provider whole.
admin.own_password: Change your own password on your account page
app.name: PolGate
app.pitch: Employees talk to a cloud model while personal data is masked locally and restored in the answer.
app.tagline: Chat with an AI model that never sees personal data
auth.locked: Too many failed attempts. This account is locked for a few minutes.
chat.caption: Personal data is masked before it reaches the model. Share only what the task needs.
chat.delete_confirm: The conversation goes with its files and its data mapping. This cannot be undone.
chat.empty: An empty message will not be sent.
chat.error_judge: The second-stage review is unavailable and the policy says to hold messages when that happens. Nothing was sent.
chat.error_refused: The hub stopped this message because it found an unmasked value it treats as sensitive. Nothing was sent.
chat.extra_terms_hint: e.g. a project name or a client's nickname
chat.indexing: Indexing the attachment to find the passages that match the question…
chat.masked_hint: How many fragments were replaced with tokens before sending.
chat.none_body: Start a new conversation. Earlier ones may have been deleted under the retention policy.
chat.nothing_masked_hint: The hub found nothing to mask in this message. Open the preview to see what the model received.
chat.print_note: Printed from the hub. Contains personal data: handle as a paper record.
chat.search_capped: The attachment is longer than the hub searches: questions only cover its first part.
chat.sweep_warning: The answer contains data that was not in your message.
chat.unprotected_hint: The administrator cleared every entity type. Your messages reach the model exactly as you write them.
error.403_body: This part of the hub is for an administrator. If you think you should see it, ask whoever set up your account.
error.404_body: The page, conversation or file you asked for does not exist, or it belongs to somebody else.
error.409_body: That message has already been sent, or it waited too long. Write it again.
error.413_body: The hub accepts files up to 10 MB. Cut out the part you need, or split the document.
error.422_body: Something is missing or in the wrong format. Go back and fill the form in again.
error.429_body: This account is locked for a few minutes. Try again shortly.
error.generic_body: The request did not go through. Try again; if it keeps happening, tell your administrator.
files.approved_flash: The file is attached to the conversation.
files.attach_hint: PDF, Word, Excel, CSV, JSON or TXT. The file is masked as soon as it is uploaded.
files.image_too_large: The picture has too many pixels to read (the limit is 50 million). Save it at a smaller size.
files.judge_unavailable: The second-stage review is unavailable and the policy says to hold files when that happens. The file was not kept.
files.rejected_flash: The file was rejected and deleted.
files.review_hint: The file on the left, what the model will see on the right. Approve to attach it.
files.too_large: File is too large (10 MB limit).
files.unpacks_too_large: Unpacked, this file is too large to read safely. Save a smaller part of the document.
files.unreadable: The file could not be read. It may be damaged or password-protected.
knowledge.add_hint: PDF, DOCX, XLSX, CSV, JSON or TXT. The hub keeps only the masked passages, not the file.
knowledge.disabled: The knowledge base is switched off in the policy: published documents are not searched.
knowledge.error_empty: No text could be read from this document.
knowledge.error_endpoint: The embedding endpoint did not answer. The document stays unpublished; try again once it is running.
knowledge.error_indexing: The document is still being masked. Publish it once it is waiting for review.
knowledge.error_masking: The document could not be masked, so nothing was kept. Check the server log for the reason.
knowledge.error_masking_off: No entity type is selected in the policy, so a document would be stored unmasked. Select the types to mask first.
knowledge.error_no_model: Publishing needs an embedding model: set EMBEDDING_MODEL first.
knowledge.error_refused: An original value was still found in the masked text, so it was refused and nothing was kept.
knowledge.error_too_long: The document has more passages than one file may (RETRIEVAL_MAX_CHUNKS_PER_FILE). Split it and upload the parts.
knowledge.intro: Regulations and procedures the whole company asks about. A document is masked once, and answers get the passages that match.
knowledge.outdated: {count} published documents have no vectors for the current embedding model and are not searched.
knowledge.published_flash: The document is published: questions in every conversation can draw on it.
knowledge.reindexed_flash: The published documents were indexed for the current embedding model.
knowledge.review_hint: This is what the search sees. The stage-2 judge does not check documents, so read it before publishing.
knowledge.unconfigured: Search is off because EMBEDDING_MODEL is not set. You can add documents but not publish them.
knowledge.withdrawn_flash: The document was withdrawn and deleted.
landing.example: Example: what an employee types and what the model sees
landing.f1_body: Data is swapped on your own server before anything reaches the provider.
landing.f2_body: Every message shows exactly what the model received.
landing.f3_body: PDF, Word, Excel and CSV are masked as they are uploaded.
landing.f4_body: Types and counts of data, never the values.
policy.allowlist_hint: Public names such as Facebook or Canva, in any case. Identifiers and the names on the other list are always masked.
policy.denylist_hint: Clients, projects and companies the model may miss. One form per line.
policy.entities_hint: Unticking every type switches masking off.
policy.judge_hint: A local model reads the masked text and looks for what still points to someone, such as a job title.
policy.names_hint: Names the hub always hides, and public names it never hides.
policy.retention_hint: After how many days data is deleted for good. Empty means no limit.
policy.review_hint: Whether a message or a file goes to the model at once, or the employee first sees what will be masked.
policy.search_hint: A long attachment is no longer cut: the model gets the passages that match the question, published knowledge base documents included.
policy.search_unconfigured: Search is off because EMBEDDING_MODEL is not set. Long files are cut.
stats.empty: Nothing yet. Send a first message.
subjects.confirm: I understand this cannot be undone
subjects.erase_hint: Replaces this person's data with a marker and deletes the vault entries and files that held it. This cannot be undone.
subjects.erased: Erased from {messages} messages, {files} files and {passages} knowledge base passages.
subjects.export_hint: This person only; everybody else stays a placeholder.
subjects.intro: A request for access or erasure. Name the person by a PESEL, an e-mail address or a full name.
subjects.nothing: Nothing the hub holds names this person.
subjects.too_short: Give at least three characters: anything shorter would match far more than one person.
subjects.value_hint: Kept out of the page address and the audit log.
